text:
Hello to kennel team,
Calm turn behind us, one thing is left: animal welfare

I want to thank everyone for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through a busy stretch at Aurelia Skyways. The pace has been calmer, but our standard stays the same: every animal is handled with care, every handoff is checked, and every carrier is moved gently by the ground team. That steady approach makes a real difference for travelers and pets alike.

Please keep using the routine checks on paperwork, crate condition, water access, and label clarity before any transfer leaves the desk. If a detail looks off, pause and bring it to the safety coordinator right away so we can review the hazard and choose the safest option. Small questions caught early save stress later, and they help us protect each animal without adding pressure to the shift.

I also want to remind everyone to keep voice levels low around the holding area and to give anxious pets a little extra patience. A calm tone, careful movement, and clean communication among the desk and ground team go a long way toward a smooth journey. Thank you for supporting one another and for keeping welfare ahead of speed in every task.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
